text: The Brooklyn Poets collective opened its eighth annual Borough Slam at the Old Stone House in Park Slope on Saturday night, drawing about 140 attendees for what organizers called their largest local turnout to date.

A new ensemble play tracing four generations of steelworkers' families opens at the Crucible Studio in Sheffield on Thursday, marking the venue's first commission from local writer Imogen Hawkridge. The 95-minute piece, titled Forge, features a six-strong cast drawn from amateur dramatic societies across South Yorkshire and runs until 24 May. Director Niamh Caulfield said rehearsals had been built around the cast's day jobs. Tickets are priced at £14, with a pay-what-you-can policy on the final Wednesday.

Mit der Eröffnung der Ausstellung „Eisenbahn und Erinnerung“ hat das Historische Museum Frankfurt am Donnerstagabend seine neue Sonderschau gestartet. Im Mittelpunkt stehen rund 180 Objekte aus den Beständen des Deutschen Bahnmuseums sowie zwölf Leihgaben aus Privatsammlungen, die der Kurator Hans-Jürgen Reibl gemeinsam mit der Düsseldorfer Historikerin Eva Kropp zusammengetragen hat. Die Schau, zu der etwa 320 geladene Gäste erschienen, läuft bis zum 14. September.

Eurovision 2026 organizers announced on Tuesday that the 70th edition of the song contest will be staged at the Wiener Stadthalle in Vienna from 12 to 16 May, with around 9,000 ticketed spectators expected at each of the two semi-finals.

Metrolink trams across Greater Manchester will come to a standstill on Thursday and Friday after drivers voted to walk out over rota changes. Operator KeolisAmey said all eight tram lines would be suspended from 04:00 on Thursday until early Saturday morning, with around 240,000 daily journeys expected to be affected. Talks between the operator and the RMT broke down on Tuesday evening.

Die U2 wird in Wien zwischen Schottentor und Karlsplatz von Freitagabend bis Montag früh komplett gesperrt, um den letzten Streckenabschnitt für die Verlängerung Richtung Matzleinsdorfer Platz an das bestehende Netz anzuschließen. Wie die Wiener Linien am Mittwoch mitteilten, sind insgesamt 71 Stunden Sperre vorgesehen, in denen rund 134.000 tägliche Fahrgäste auf einen Schienenersatzverkehr mit zwölf Bussen sowie auf die Straßenbahnlinien D, 71 und 1 ausweichen müssen. Die Verlängerung der U2 soll planmäßig im Herbst 2027 in Betrieb gehen.

Bristol's long-delayed e-bike scheme finally launched on Monday morning, with 600 vehicles distributed across 80 stations from Bedminster to Stoke Bishop. The £4.2 million programme, run by Beryl on a five-year contract with Bristol City Council, will cost users £1 to unlock plus 12p per minute. Council transport lead Aamir Khan-Rashid said the rollout had taken eighteen months longer than planned.
British Airways cancelled 47 short-haul flights from Heathrow on Wednesday after a baggage-system outage at Terminal 5, affecting roughly 9,300 passengers.
Cardinal Hayes High School in the Bronx defeated rival Mount St. Michael Academy 71-58 on Friday night before a near-capacity crowd of 1,200, securing a top seed in the CHSAA playoffs.

Glamorgan eased to a six-wicket victory over Worcestershire in their County Championship Division Two opener at Sophia Gardens in Cardiff on Saturday, with overseas signing Marnus Steyn top-scoring with 87 not out.
Die SV Elversberg setzte sich am Samstag im Heimspiel der Regionalliga Südwest mit 2:1 gegen Eintracht Trier durch; das Tor zum Sieg fiel in der 87. Minute durch Linus Vorbach vor 4.380 Zuschauern.

Manchester City booked their place in the Champions League quarter-finals on Tuesday with a 3-1 home win over Real Madrid at the Etihad Stadium, taking the tie 4-2 on aggregate; Kasper Vinterberg netted twice for the hosts before 53,400 fans.
The Pennsylvania Senate passed a closely watched school-funding bill 28-21 on Wednesday, with three Republicans crossing party lines to back the Democratic-sponsored measure.

Der Wiener Gemeinderat hat am Donnerstag mit 61 zu 39 Stimmen die Erhöhung der Parkgebühren in den Innenbezirken beschlossen. Für den Antrag der Koalition aus SPÖ und Neos stimmten neben den 65 Mandataren der beiden Fraktionen auch zwei Abgeordnete der Grünen. Die ÖVP und die FPÖ kündigten in der Debatte Verfassungsbeschwerden an.

Labour comfortably held the Rochdale parliamentary seat in Thursday's by-election, with candidate Sarah Wainwright taking 47.3% of the vote on a 38% turnout. The Conservatives slipped to fourth place behind Reform UK and the Liberal Democrats, polling just 9.1%. Returning officer Margaret Chen-Doherty announced the result shortly after 02:00 on Friday.

Der Bundestag hat am Freitag das Gesetz zur Reform der Pflegeversicherung in dritter Lesung verabschiedet. Mit 412 Ja-Stimmen bei 198 Gegenstimmen und 14 Enthaltungen passierte die Vorlage der Ampel-Koalition aus SPD, Grünen und FDP das Parlament, während CDU/CSU und AfD geschlossen dagegen votierten. Gesundheitsminister Friedrich Heimann sprach von einem Generationenwerk.

The 31st Three Rivers Half Marathon set off from Point State Park in Pittsburgh on Sunday morning, with about 9,800 registered runners. Race officials said Wesley Akinwale took the men's title in 1:04:12, while Sara Malone won the women's race in 1:13:48. The Port Authority diverted four bus routes and closed the Boulevard of the Allies between 6 a.m. and noon.

Das Berliner Abgeordnetenhaus hat am Donnerstag mit 87 zu 73 Stimmen die Einführung einer Citymaut für die Innenstadt beschlossen. Im Zuge der Vorbereitungen werden die BVG-Buslinien 100 und 200 ab 1. Juli vorübergehend über den Spittelmarkt umgeleitet. Stadtentwicklungssenatorin Linda Wessel sagte, mit der Maßnahme würden täglich rund 60.000 Fahrzeuge aus der Mitte ferngehalten.

Austin's annual East Side Block Festival kicked off on Saturday afternoon, with five city blocks along East 11th Street closed to traffic until late Sunday evening. Capital Metro rerouted the 17 and 30 bus lines through East 12th Street. By 10 p.m., police estimated the crowd at roughly 14,500, the festival's largest opening night since its 2017 debut.

Plans to extend the Glasgow Subway out to Drumchapel are facing renewed opposition from residents in the Anniesland area, who say the proposed alignment cuts too close to existing housing. Strathclyde Partnership for Transport published an updated feasibility study last week putting the cost of the eight-station extension at £640 million, well above the £450 million estimate from 2019. A public consultation closed in March without a clear preferred route.
